mechanism.name: phase-locked loop phase tracking
mechanism.principle: A phase detector, PI loop filter and VCO form a feedback loop that drives phase error toward zero and tracks a reference frequency.
laws: pd = kpd * sin(phi_ref - phi_vco); integral += ki * pd; control = loop_gain * pd + integral; f_vco = f0 + kvco * control; phi_vco += 2*pi * f_vco / sample_rate
invariants: the VCO phase is the accumulated frequency state
the phase detector compares reference and VCO phase modulo 2*pi
the declared type-2 loop drives frequency error and phase error toward zero in the test
